testing.counts: 50 passed, 3 skipped (after moving import in test file)

side_effects.detail: No Redis server is available, so the 3 Redis-backed tests (including test_get_or_compute_caches_falsy_value) were skipped; the get_or_compute fix is covered instead by a new test that uses an in-memory fake client.
Running pytest wrote .pytest_cache/ and __pycache__/ directories, which are gitignored and were already there.

summary: Fixed three bugs. (1) RedisCache.get_or_compute now treats only a missing key (raw None) as a miss, so falsy values like 0, '', [] are cached. (2) LRUCache.get now marks the entry as recently used, so entries that are read are not the first evicted. (3) serializers.dumps now writes datetime/date as ISO 8601 strings. Added a parametrized fake-client test for falsy values. The existing failing tests now pass: 50 passed, 3 skipped because Redis is unavailable.
